info.title: WMS_HoaNam API
info.description: OpenAPI route surface is generated from the real Laravel /api/v1 route list. Business semantics follow HN-BA-MASTER-DEVTEST-001 v1.0 and HN-WMS-ERD-DD-001 v1.0 (04/08/2026). MVP is full-post only, has no Stocktake scope, and uses inventory movements as the authoritative ledger. Envelope: {success, message, data, meta, links, error}.
